name: Greater Enspelling Script
body:
You can create even more powerful effects with your secret writing.

Prerequisite(s): Int 17, Linguistics 11 ranks, Spellcraft 11 ranks, 6th-level chronicler

Benefit: This feat functions as Enspelling Script, except that if you spend an additional hour (for a total of two extra hours) enchanting your writing, you may choose from one of the following effects instead of the Enspelling Script effects: the reader takes 168 damage per level of chronicler you possess; or the reader is knocked unconscious; or the reader is affected as by a charm monster spell that you cast on them for 1 minute per level; or the reader believes a false, alternate message is written rather than the actual text. This message can be no longer than the true text written.
